events.title: Streetlight Manifesto
about: Seven guys, seven different musical backgrounds, seven different personalities, one band, one unique and unmistakable voice. Formed in New Jersey as an ad hoc group intended to put out one album and disappear, one thing led to another, and within a few months of their debut release, Everything Goes Numb, Streetlight Manifesto was officially a full-time touring band, traveling the world, spreading their infectious and energetic tunes to all who would listen. A high energy rock band with more horn players than traditional rock instruments, with influences from Latin, klezmer, folk, world, funk, jazz, and classical music all blending into one cohesive sound, the band has somehow come a long way from where they started while staying true to their DIY roots. Twenty years later, the guys are still at it, still performing live to sold-out shows filled with sweat-drenched fans, all dancing and singing along at the top of their lungs.

events.title: ALLEYCVT
about: Since debuting her project in 2021, ALLEYCVT’s quick rise to stardom can be attributed to the rare trifecta of talent she boasts as a skilled producer, singer/songwriter and DJ. Her alluring pop-adjacent vocals blend seamlessly with her heavy bass-filled drops, cementing her as a force to be reckoned with as she continues her meteoric rise. In a short span, she’s quickly found home on tastemaker labels like Deadbeats, Wubaholics and independent releases on her own label, garnering over 7 million streams across her catalog on Spotify alone. With influences like Flux Pavillion, Zeds Dead, and Subtronics, ALLEYCVT’s brilliance will endure through her siren-like melodies and captivating lyrics.

events.title: Country 102.5's Acoustic Christmas
events.detail: with ft. Cole Swindell, Chase Matthew, Scotty McCreery, and Jackson Dean
about: Join Country 102.5 for a special acoustic evening featuring country superstars Cole Swindell, Scotty McCreery, Chase Matthew, and Jackson Dean - December 7 at Roadrunner in Boston. Experience intimate performances, unforgettable stories, and stripped-down sets from some of country music's biggest stars in a unique setting at one of Boston's best concert venues. A portion of ticket proceeds will benefit Christmas in the City, a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping Boston-area families experiencing homelessness and poverty. Through year-round programs and holiday initiatives, the organization works to ensure that every child can experience the magic of the season, regardless of their family's financial circumstances. Come together with Country 102.5 for an unforgettable night of music, community, and giving back. Enjoy performances from your favorite country artists while helping make a meaningful difference for local families this holiday season.

events.title: Daily Bread
about: Repping Atlanta proudly, Daily Bread—Rhett Whatley’s sonic perception—is always coming with fresh ideas to give soul-stirring sounds a trenchant edge. The Philos Records resident’s penchant for experimenting with instruments and an intense affinity for crate-digging helps Daily Bread rise to new heights, bringing together nostalgically soulful melodies, gritty hip-hop hooks, and bass-driven flare into one cohesive sound. Boasting an accomplished goal of bringing old sounds to new ears, Daily Bread’s trajectory has been divinely unpredictable. With merch selling out in mere minutes, vinyl being resold for hundreds of dollars, and a legion of supporters consistently waiting for Daily Bread’s next move, Whatley’s flame isn’t going out just yet. In fact, the heat only continues to rise.

events.title: Converge Presents: Saddest Day 2026
events.detail: with Neurosis, Converge, Crowbar, Cave In, Emma Ruth Rundle, Pig Pen, Deaf Club, Final Gasp
about: It never ceases to amaze me how the things we initially dismiss, overlook, don't notice can become the most important and meaningful to us and our lives.The first time I saw Converge was in 1996 with Deadguy, Coalesce and a number of other bands whose names are now lost to memory in a Legion Hall in a rundown part of Buffalo, NY. I'd like to say they changed my life that night but they didn't - not that night, anyway. However, there was something about the way their rail-thin singer (Jacob Bannon) threw himself without regard into his performance, and the audience, and glimpses of the more than then-typical Victory Records mosh in their music that spoke of things to come. If you told me that band (Converge, I would discover later while buying Deadguy merch) would become one of the most important to not only myself but to aggressive music and its various scenes and factions, I would have cracked a smile, at the very least. Funny, how things turn out. Formed in the winter of 1990 in Boston, MA, during the rise and subsequent fall of the legendary Boston hardcore scene, Converge are unarguably one of the most important bands in the history of aggressive music. Through numerous line-up changes (the band are currently comprised of vocalist/visual design terrorist Jacob Bannon, drummer Ben Koller, guitarist/back-up vocalist Kurt Ballou and bassist/back-up vocalist Nate Newton), musical trends (mosh, tech, guys crying and wearing make-up, '80s thrash revival) and the coming and going of more "the next great thing" than I care to recall, Converge have established themselves as leaders in the aggressive music underground. It seems redundant to use the word "landmark" when discussing their musical canon, as almost every album is genre-defining, but Converge's run is unparalleled. Releases such as Petitioning the Empty Sky (1997), When Forever Comes Crashing (1998), Jane Doe (2001), You Fail Me (2004) and No Heroes (2006) have established Converge as trendsetters and innovators, setting new standards in hardcore and metal with each release. These records have evolved the band (from their thrash-inspired, hardcore-drenched beginnings to slower, more ominous and atmospheric work to all-out Tsunami-of-hostility hell-bent on levelling creation) and produced new waves of followers and emulators with each successive work. Honestly, has there been a band more influential on…

events.detail: with Converge "25th Anniversary Jane Doe Set", Chat Pile, Baroness, Agriculture, Deadguy, Reversal Of Man, Habak, Fuming Mouth

events.title: Embrace Honors MLK: One Night. One Boston. Fifth Annual Celebration
about: Join Embrace Boston for the fifth annual Embrace Honors MLK, a celebration of the people, culture, and connections that bring our city together. This year’s theme, One Night. One Boston., invites us to celebrate across neighborhoods, generations, and experiences through the universal language of music, the joy of gathering, and the power of community.

Taking place at Roadrunner, this year’s celebration will feature a special guest headliner and honor the enduring legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. alongside the centennial of Mrs. Coretta Scott King. As part of the MLK Weekend coalition, Embrace Boston will also recognize changemakers whose leadership and contributions continue to advance justice and strengthen our communities.

Every ticket purchase is a donation to Embrace Boston. Your support goes directly to our work, from monuments, research and storytelling to neighborhood activations and building our new civic and cultural home for belonging at 33–41 West Street in Downtown Crossing.
Come celebrate Black culture, honor those moving our communities forward, and experience a night of music, connection, and collective joy. One night. One Boston. Be part of it.
For more information and to see last year's recap video, visit

events.title: D.O.D
about: D.O.D has well and truly found the sweet spot between fun and fame after starting off his DJ career playing in local bars and clubs in his hometown of Bury in Manchester. He chalked up multiple #1s on Beatport and gathered well over a hundred million plays across the most popular streaming portals. Although much of his success on the live front happened overseas with spots at gargantuan festivals such as Tomorrowland, Ultra and Creamfields, he also cultivates a commendable list of UK events, clubs and festivals he’s played at, including Ministry of Sound, Cream and Warehouse Project. His recent sold-out tours across the US and UK followed the success of his first UK Top 40 single, ‘So Much In Love,’ and paved the way for his latest track, ‘Somedays’ with Sonny Fodera and Jazzy, which shot to #5 on the UK Official Top 40 and claimed the #1 spot on the Official Dance Singles Chart.

events.title: Chelsea Cutler
about: Chelsea Cutler captures the sound of vulnerability and self-discovery, leaning into discomfort and emerging with a confidence that can only be earned through growth. One song might dry the tears of heartbreak and disappointment with genuine empathy, while another could just as easily soundtrack an emotional comeback with a lyrical affirmation. She makes anthemic pop with singer-songwriter earnestness, infusing big feelings into bold hooks.

The multi-platinum singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and producer isn’t afraid to speak her mind or wear her heart on her sleeve. This approach has endeared Chelsea to a devout audience around the world. In addition to amassing billions of streams across her catalogue, she has garnered six Gold singles and two Platinum singles. Thus far, she has delivered three fan-favorite albums: How To Be Human [2020], When I Close My Eyes [2021], and Stellaria [2023], earning acclaim from Billboard, Variety, The New York Times, Los Angeles Times, Wall Street Journal, Associated Press, NPR, Forbes 30 Under 30, and more. In between her albums, Chelsea and Jeremy Zucker collaborated on the acclaimed brent EP [2019], brent ii EP [2021], and brent iii album [2024], followed by their first-ever tour together, which was completely sold out. She has also sold out worldwide headline tours, lent her voice to tracks with Noah Kahan, Kygo, Quinn XCII, Louis The Child, and others, and performed on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, Late Night with Seth Meyers, and Today Show.

After the Brent Forever Tour with Jeremy, Chelsea spent much of 2025 at home in New York City, stepping away from the nightly rhythm of touring and into an expected period of her life that found her newly single after a serious relationship. She was experiencing a kind of post-breakup freedom that had rarely appeared in her music before, as she went out, met new people, dated, and moved through the highs and lows that came with figuring out who she was on her own. Along the way, she rediscovered inspirations in books, films, and artists, including M83, Bon Iver, Mk.gee, and Clams Casino, allowing creativity to return on its own terms without pressure or expectation.
That freedom opened the door to IS THIS THE END?, Chelsea’s fourth studio album, arriving September 25th via Mercury Records. Deeply influenced by New York City and the experiences that…

events.title: TWINSICK
about: TWINSICK features the talents of Minneapolis, MN na8ves Alex Ingalls and Casey Schneider. Upon forming the duo in late 2019, the boys quickly amassed worldwide aKen8on for their unique melodic and dance music. Ini8ally known for their popular remix and mashup hits, TWINSICK's sound has resonated across the global dance music scene. The duo con8nues to thrive in top markets, performing on main stages at major fes8vals like Lollapalooza, Veld, and Global Dance Fes8val, as well as headlining some of the world’s most iconic nightclubs, including Marquee New York, Liv Miami, and Omnia Las Vegas.

events.title: Lucy Bedroque
about: Los Angeles based nineteen year old Jeremiah Mark (they/he) released their first full-length endeavor under the moniker Lucy Bedroque, their deadAir Records debut. With no prior singles, the breakneck seventeen track shotgun blast of Digicore and Hardcore Hip Hop, titled “Unmusique” has established them as a bastion of these underground sounds. The release date coincided with their first show on the Jane Remover and Dazegxd tour “TURN UP OR DIE”, along with a full west coast run. Leading up to this moment, Lucy Bedroque gained a cult following in the shadowy sectors of the online underground, with a break-out debut LP “Sisterhood” as Lostrushi. This is the name that raised them to notoriety alongside peers 9lives, prettifun, and egobreak. The new material continues further down the same path, combining cutthroat rage, with the eclecticism and sensitivities of Stereolab, Radiohead, and Deftones. While forging their distinct multi-media surrealism, Mark also found a penchant for customized linguistics and contorting the English language. Most notably, the title “Glutmother” (the name fans chose for a hyper-active Subreddit) graces the cover art of the debut and the packaging of “Unmusique. “The role of motherhood here is representative of a superiority to everything around it. But beyond humans, it’s a reference to mother nature and creation.” They explain. As for why it’s juxtaposed with gluttony, that’s because “People want more than anyone can handle, and I’ve responded to it with a perfectionist’s mindset.” They combine into a deep resonance of identity that'd easily evade a new listener. Artful self-produced digicore songs are weaved into a credits list that resembles a guide to online underground music. SKAI (Ken Carson, Osamason producer), Cranes (xaviersobased, Nettspend) also underpin hooks and multi-octave vocal acrobatics.

events.title: PORTUGAL. THE MAN : IN THE MOUNTAIN IN THE CLOUD – 15 Year Anniversary Tour
about: Over the past decade, Portugal. The Man has established themselves as one of rock’s most prized possessions and a live phenomenon, with over 1,600 shows under their belts and a storied reputation as festival favorites.

Originally heralding from Alaska, the Portland-based band soared to new heights in 2017 with the release of their now RIAA certified-Platinum album, Woodstock. The album was marked by the astounding success of their infectious single, “Feel It Still,” which earned the group a plethora of new accolades – including a GRAMMY for “Best Pop Duo/Group Performance,” a 7x RIAA Platinum certification, a record setting 20-week residency at #1 on alternative radio, and an inescapable presence on the Top 40 airwaves.

Alongside the shine of their myriad of musical accomplishments lies the group’s long-standing passion for social justice. In fact, this is precisely the intersection in which Portugal. The Man thrives; throughout their career, the band has consistently exemplified how to deeply commit to both artistry and activism. This ultimately inspired them to officially launch PTM Foundation in 2020, focused on universal issues related to human rights, community health, and the environment, with an emphasis on causes directly impacting Indigenous Peoples, including Alaska Native Health (providing the highest quality of health services for Alaska Native people) and Seeding Sovereignty (radicalizing and disrupting colonized spaces through land, body, food sovereignty work and more).

Portugal. The Man have also partnered with an array of organizations such as National Coalition Against Censorship, The Skatepark Project (helping communities build public skate parks for youth in underserved communities), March for Our Lives (Gun Reform), Keep Oregon Well (Mental Health), and Protect Our Winters (Climate Change), to name just a few. In 2022, the band furthered their passion for activism when they launched PTM’s NIGHT OUT initiative – supporting disabled fans requiring ADA access.

events.title: Know Good Presents: Against All Odds Tour
about: KNOW GOOD is the product of two kindred spirits bound by both blood and bass. Cousins Tanner and Sylas Morgan are the latest in a family legacy of musicians, crafting a genre-defying sound that’s as dark and dynamic as it is unexpected. Their music pulses with low frequencies woven through pop, rock, and rap elements.

Both veterans in their own right, Sylas has spent the past decade DJing nightclubs and bars across the U.S., known for his taste in sample selection and sharp verses, while Tanner brings versatility as a vocalist and multi-instrumentalist, mastering over ten instruments.

Since joining forces in 2020, KNOW GOOD has created a fresh sound that’s quickly gaining traction. Their live performances blend the intensity of a DJ set with the richness of live instrumentation, incorporating drums, guitar, violin, and vocals. Set to tour nationally in 2025, KNOW GOOD is making waves with a style that’s as dynamic as it is innovative, captivating listeners and earning spins from the world’s top DJs.;(

events.title: The Womack Sisters
about: The Womack Sisters Kucha, Zeimani, and BG Womack were singing before they could walk. They grew up on the road. Their schools were stages and studios all over the world, where they sang behind their parents, Zekkariyas & Zeriiya (fka Womack & Womack), alongside their four siblings. Nowhere was home for long. No matter where they lived—London, Thailand, Amsterdam, Kenya, Paris, Sydney, Zurich, Vienna, Tanzania, New York, Miami, West Virginia, the Bahamas—they were always surrounded by music and family.

In 2007, the Sisters decided to strike out on their own, leaving their family to pursue their own dreams back in the States. They moved to Los Angeles and connected with their uncle Bobby Womack, brother Meech Wells and industry, singing at open mics, working as background vocalists and arranging and writing for artists including Mya, Earl St. Clair, The Game, B.O.B, Eddie Murphy, and Solange Knowles.

The next decade would prove particularly challenging. The loss of their father Zekkariyas (fka Cecil Womack) and the declining health and eventual passing of their uncle Bobby forced the Sisters to take time away from their careers to focus on their personal lives. They moved into an abandoned rehearsal hall where they could write and rehearse in the hours between trying to make ends meet, at various times working as caregivers, nannies, Uber drivers, and house cleaners. It was during this time they recorded and independently released their debut single, “Darling”, which the Sisters wrote and produced in tribute to the Womack brothers.

A glimpse of brighter things to come came in 2016, when a mutual friend introduced the Sisters to Daptone Records producer Gabriel Roth (AKA Bosco Mann.) “The chemistry was instant and undeniable,” recalls Roth. “For me it was never about their name. They sang for me and I just fell in love with their voices. I knew we had to make music together.” They cut their first 45 together, “If You Want Me” b/w “I Just Don’t Want You (To Say Goodbye),” soon after their first meeting, though it would be shelved indefinitely due to the Sisters’ contractual obligations.

The Sisters returned to the studio in 2022 to record their EP, Legacy, featuring their rendition of “A Change is Gonna Come” to honor their grandfather Sam Cooke. Though their lineage had always been an anchor for them, tying them to the rich musical tradition of their family, it…

events.title: Braxton Keith
events.detail: with Carson Peters and Iron Mountain
about: With a sound and style honed in the honky tonks of Texas and beyond, Braxton Keith is part of a new generation of country singer-songwriter – one leading a revival of its core creative tenants.

Featuring an earnest love of the ‘80s country aesthetic – and all but addicted to the rush of the stage – Keith has spent the last few years of life as a proud road dog, schooling new fans of the timeless power of a revved up band and rich organic twang. But while his what-you-see-is-what-you-get approach remains firmly rooted in tradition, that doesn’t mean he’s staying put. This Warner Music Nashville newcomer lives one state line at a time.

“I love the honky tonk country twang and I wouldn’t trade it for anything,” the rising star explains. “But honestly, I’m just thinking about getting up and playing another show. This is just the beginning. This is where the hard work starts.”

A proud Texas native who these days splits time between San Antonio and Nashville, Keith was born in Midland, Texas, steeped in country mystique. Learning to play piano from his grandmother – a woman who loved the Cadillac cool of stars like Porter Wagoner – he grew up singing, drawn like a magnet to the sonic storytelling of gritty tunes like “The Carroll County Accident” (an all-time family favorite).

Diving deep into the pure-country form, Keith picked up a guitar and soon had a taste for hard twang and tales of the heart, writing his own classically-inspired songs in a grungy, cluttered garage. He never took it seriously until college, when a friend convinced the unknown-but-obvious talent to record one – just so he’d have something to share with his future kids.

“I did it – and I never stopped,” Keith says. “I caught this little honky tonk bug, and now I’m traveling the country for a living. Started out writing songs in our garage, now I’m writing songs in Nashville. It’s crazy.”

Leaving school behind to earn his place in Texas’ vibrant live-music scene, Keith and a band of brothers have now been touring nonstop since 2020, racking up untold miles and hundreds of floorboard-shaking shows. Blending throwback-tonk with a sharp, barbed-wire vocal recalling stars like Tracy Lawrence (plus a little borderland buzz of San Antonio Spanish influence), Keith became a regular face in venues all across his home state, and then looked beyond.
Relentless nationwide touring and a series of self-released…

events.title: Dogpark
about: Dogpark, an emerging East Coast band, was forged in the basements and backyards of University of Richmond in 2023. What began as a medley of jazz and a cappella club misfits turned into four-hour sets at beer-covered frat parties and, eventually, a high-flying and highly capable indie rock act cultivating audiences across the country. The band features Eamon Moore (lead vocals), Christian Conte (drums), Declan Harris (lead guitar), Billy Apostolou (guitar), and Will Harford (vocals/bass).

Their infectious stage presence and homage to the indie-rock of the 90s has elevated them from an unrefined cover band to a commanding force to be reckoned with. Their debut EP, ‘Breaking in Brooklyn,’ was released in January 2024, showcasing their ambition and tenacious musicality, all the while setting the stage for their next batch of releases that highlight the evolved taste and synergy of the young indie rock band. This includes the highly anticipated single “Caviar”, out September 17th. Dogpark is currently preparing for their 35-date headlining “Breaking in America 2024” Tour, which will run from September to December, marking a significant milestone in their rapidly ascending career.

events.title: Bad Suns
about: Bad Suns is Christo Bowman (vocals/guitar), Gavin Bennett (bass) and Miles Morris (drums). The band's catalog includes 2014’s Language & Perspective, which peaked at #24 on the Billboard 200, and 2016’s Disappear Here, which launched the LA-based trio onto tours with the likes of The 1975 and Halsey, festivals including Coachella, and the homepages of Alternative Press and NYLON — with the latter hailing Bad Suns as “the sort of rock that we just never get enough of.”

Following the release of their 2023 EP Infinite Joy, which earned considerable support from Alt Nation, and a full US tour supporting The Band Camino, Bad Suns entered their next chapter with the release of Accelerator in 2025. The album’s lead single “Communicating” received profound support at Alternative Radio, while Rolling Stone hailed Accelerator as “their most compelling in nearly a decade". Now, Bad Suns are celebrating the anniversary of Disappear Here with a special tour honoring the album that helped define their early career.

events.title: BABYFXCE E
about: In an era defined by genre-bending sensibilities and vocal filters, Babyfxce E raps with piercing clarity, urgent words that penetrate through sparse, trunk-rattling beats that have become synonymous with Flint, Michigan.

Flint— Babyfxce E’s hometown— has become an influential breeding ground for Hip-Hop music on a national stage. For the last several years, it’s been intrinsically tied to poverty, bleak economics, unsafe drinking water, and general suffering. What the national media doesn’t tell you, though, is that Flint is full of spirit. Talent abounds; struggles become a petri dish for inspiration. Babyfxce E is the next buzzing talent in a long line of Flint rappers of the past few years (Rio Da Yung OG, Louie Ray, YN Jay, and RMC Mike, just to name a few.)

While making ends meet in the streets of North Flint, Babyfxce E was surrounded by creative talent, and began to rap casually around his peers. It was after about six months— around the time he recorded his third song— when he realized his gift with the pen. Still a teenager, he became a student of the game, listening to burgeoning local acts as well as national stars such as NBA YoungBoy and Lil Baby — these would become his biggest influences down the line.

As Babyfxce E began to take rap seriously, he noticed the accolades mounting. His career really took off, in his own eyes, on the heels of the single “Six Flags” in 2022, which paved the way for projects such as Life Of The Reaper and Its Wit a X. Shortly after, E gave a performance in his hometown, and the crowd knew every word— ever since, he says, nothing’s been the same.

Over the past few years Babyfxce E has been consistently churning out quality music. In early 2024, he inked a deal with Atlantic Records and released the deluxe edition of his critically acclaimed mixtape, The X Tape. The 21-track project featured guest appearances from BabyTron, Skilla Baby, SleazyWorld Go, Luh Tyler and more. He quickly followed up with another mixtape Real Striker Music, which showcased his musical versatility with pop hooks over richly textured melodic production and vivid imagery of lived experiences. Later that year, he embarked on a 16-city North American tour as direct support for Detroit artist Babyface Ray and his Wavy Navy University Tour.
Babyfxce E continued his upward momentum in 2025 with the release of M Block and M Block (Deluxe). The rising…

events.title: Shakey Graves
about: Across his career, Shakey Graves—a.k.a. the performance moniker of Austin, Texas-born Alejandro Rose-Garcia—has intentionally created thrilling musical adventures tailored to each fan: burning CDs and putting them in personalized decorated bags; building intricate scavenger hunts that send fans in search of unique tapes; and Bandcamp-exclusive releases.

"The fans and musicians that really resonate with me—and the inexplicable ways that I find things that I like—are usually entirely through randomness and chaos and accident," Rose-Garcia says. "I've always been on this quest to make people feel like my own music is a choose your own adventure."

In 2024 Rose-Garcia celebrated the ten year anniversary of his And The War Came album with a special 10 Year Anniversary Edition release featuring never before heard demos and b-sides from the recording process and inviting fans to enter the long-since abandoned Music House.
His story continues to unfold, but Shakey Graves Is Still A Gentleman From Texas.

events.title: feeble little horse
about: feeble little horse is naturally delighted to present their third full-length LP, bitknot. The album was written, arranged, produced, and recorded by Sebastian Kinsler, Lydia Slocum, and Jake Kelley across their respective homes in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

A spirited investigation into the unnatural space created between human nature and a culture of convenience, a synthesis of dirt and digital, bitknot by feeble little horse creates a language wherein one can re-imbue a sanctity of interdependence away from consumptive “self-sufficiency” and materialism. “The album art is based on the coincidental core memory matrix, which was used in old computers to store memory / access information using 0s and 1s. Each core, or ‘bit,’ is accessed through the grid of wires, like a knot that stores secret details and memories.” bitknot asks that we find new modes of being through this grid, entrusting one another with the collaborative construction of these knots. This negotiation with an ever-developing hybrid reality is expertly exemplified in the album’s production – the buoyancy of Kinsler’s arrangements provide a perfectly balanced surface tension for the weight of Slocum’s meandering introspection as they playfully harmonize against saccharine hooks, walls of noise, a supercharged car battery’s worth of synths and samples dropped in the ocean of their guitar-driven songwriting framework, and some of Kelley’s most laser-focused drums to date to create a sonic chimera that is as likely to be found nascently developing in the early aughts as some unknown, chromatic future.

Rhymes written with sidewalk chalk that refuse to be erased in the Anthropocene’s acid rain of destructive relationships, Herbert Marcuse’s One-Dimensional Man manifest through the spirit of a young woman born in the shadow of the Steel City’s industrial ghosts, a study of the clumsy alchemy of IRL and WWW – it is within these rhizomatic contradictions that bitknot proliferates.

events.title: 15th Annual David Boobie
about: Instead of shopping on Black Friday Weekend, come worship at the church of Bowie! All the Burlesque you want, all the Bowie you NEED! The holidays are approaching once again, which means its time for the glorious return of the Bowiest of Showies! Niki Starbust Luparelli and her all grrrl Total Blam Blam David Boobie Band bring to the Crystal Ballroom their yearly tribute to the King of Glitter Rock! Rather than pushing through the market square on Black Friday Weekend, driving like a demon from station to station, and running wild through a million dead end streets in search of Christmas bargains, you should instead spit in the eyes of fools, put on your red shoes, and run to the centre of things, the Crystal Ballroom, that is, where each table offers a seat with the clearest view, and femme fatales emerge from shadows, dancing to the best of Bowie, ALL NIGHT LONG

about: LET'S ROCK CANCER! 2026 Dedicated to Linda Pardee Hosted by the one and only Henry Santoro Featuring Live Music by Jeffery Robbins of Orbit - with celebration of Linda Pardee (bass & vox for Orbit, Chelsea Curve) Muck & the Mires The Ray Liriano Experience...GO! and special guests Proceeds from this all ages event benefit the Cancer Care Access Program at Dana-Farber, which aims to reduce disparities in cancer outcomes among local communities. Established in 2012, the Program broadens access to historically marginalized patient populations and joins our community partners in the pursuit of equitable care across the spectrum of cancer-related diseases.

events.title: The Sweetback Sisters - XMAS Sing Along Spectacular
about: Celebrating 20 Years! Every family has its Christmas traditions. The cookies. The tree. The ornament that's been hanging on by a thread since 1987. For thousands of people across the country, The Sweetback Sisters' Country Christmas Sing-Along Spectacular has become one of them. For twenty years, audiences have gathered for an evening that feels less like a concert and more like the Christmas party everyone wishes they'd been invited to. One part country music revue, one part vintage holiday variety show, and one part joyful audience sing-along, the Spectacular is filled with classic carols, country Christmas favorites, forgotten seasonal gems, quirky originals, surprisingly consequential holiday trivia, improbable prizes, and enough laughter to keep winter at bay.

events.title: Damir Imamovic
about: Vivo Performing Arts presents Damir Imamovic Bosnian singer-songwriter Damir Imamovic, with his trio, shares the narrative power, the gorgeous melancholy, and the yearning inherent in sevdah music. Sometimes called 'Bosnian blues' or sevdalinka, the music reflects Bosnia's rich cultural history: Roma, Slavic, and Sephardic Jewish influences meld with sounds from across the Ottoman Empire. Imamovic, a Sarajevo-born artist with deep family roots in Balkan music, preserves folk tradition while creating music that's evolving and vibrantly alive.

events.title: Flor de Toloache
about: Vivo Performing Arts presents Flor de Toloache The talents of Latin Grammy winners Flor de Toloache cast a spell on audiences that can be felt down to the marrow. Fans and reviewers describe their shows as spiritual, their voices like healing crystals, their sisterhood on stage setting a new standard for what a concert can be. Led by Mireya Ramos and Shae Fiol, the NYC-based ensemble draws from ranchera, cumbia, salsa, jazz, and rock, weaving it all into something that feels like solidarity made sound. Bold, virtuosic, and completely themselves, Flor de Toloache push mariachi somewhere it has never been before.

events.title: Midway or the Highway Open Mic
about: NO COVER! · 21+ · Doors at 8:00 PM · Show at 9:00 pm

Welcome to our show. Ever wondered what hilarious comedians from big fancy TV shows do the rest of the week? Sometimes they appear at your neighborhood bar! The funniest in New England and beyond can now be found in the wilds of JP on every single Sunday night at 9pm FOR FREE. Also featuring, cheap beers!

Even better, if you stick around after 10pm, our show magically transforms into an open mic! You can see some of the city’s best, whether it’s comedians, musicians, poets, sketch performers, or storytellers, working out their kinks and developing their craft. If you’re interested in performing at the mic, it’s super easy. Just arrive, write your name down on a list, and next thing you know you’ll be onstage! Sets are 5 minutes or 2 songs, depending on what you do.

And there’s more! Midway Or The Highway Presents a whole extra bonus show every fourth Wednesday from 6 - 8pm. Unbelievable comics from New England and beyond forego fancy places to come through and test their mettle against one of our wild obstacles/themes. Just five bucks fixes your whole week! Check out our Facebook for the latest lineup!
Your host is Angela Sawyer. She can’t wait to see you laughing.

Your host is Angela Sawyer. She can’t wait to see you laughing.

events.title: Club d’Elf feat Rob Compa and Vicente Lebron Early Show
about: Club d'Elf returns to the Lizard Lounge with special guests Rob Compa and Vicente Lebron Nov 28th!
Event is 21+ · $30/$35 GA · $80 reserved table · Doors 6:30

Club d’Elf returns to the Lizard Lounge Nov 28th for two post Thanksgiving shows! The line up features Rob Compa (guitar), Mister Rourke (turntables), Paul Schultheis (keys) Mike Rivard (bass & sintir), Vicente Lebron (congas) and Dean Johnston (drums). The band played its first show at The Lizard in Feb 1998 and began a residency that ran until March 2020. The Lizard has always been home for d’Elf and the band loves to return whenever the opportunity arises.

What begins as a groove in Club d’Elf’s world often becomes a doorway into someplace older, stranger and unshackled by time.The band has spent twenty seven years helping audiences lose track of time with its shape-shifting fusion of Moroccan trance, dub, electronica, jazz and improvised funk. Built around bassist and composer Mike Rivard, each performance features a rotating cast drawn from Boston, New York and beyond, creating a constantly shifting ecosystem where trance forms the central core of the band’s aesthetic. Under the tutelage of longtime member and Casablanca native Brahim Fribgane, the group absorbed Moroccan trance music deeply into its DNA. Fribgane passed away in early 2024, but his spirit remains embedded in the band’s sound, especially through Rivard’s commanding sintir work, learned under the guidance of Fribgane and Gnawa masters Hassan Hakmoun and Mahmoud Guinia.

Their new album, Loon and Thrush (released 4/10/26), recorded entirely live in the studio with minimal overdubs, channels that lineage into a raw, improvisatory flight. While largely built on Rivard originals, the album continues the band’s tradition of honoring key influences, offering Moroccan-infused takes on Grateful Dead classics “Bird Song” and “New Speedway Boogie.” The overarching theme of the record is“flight” itself—the avian imagery of the title track, the Dead’s celestial wanderings, and the enduring presence of Fribgane, whose spirit continues to guide the music from beyond.

“…Club d’Elf’s treatment does something impressive. Stripped of words, the first-rate improvisers’ take on the classic track summons lyrics where there are none, using instrumental gravitas that allows the track to flap its wings, take flight, and gain new elevation.” – Relix on “Bird…

events.title: Madoc “Cake” Single Release with Prophet PM
about: Madoc releases her highly anticipated single, “Cake” with special guest Prophet PM at the Lizard Lounge Dec 4th!
$20 adv/$25 door · Doors 7

Taking inspiration from her Pacific Northwest and Irish roots, Madóc (she/they) is a Boston-based queer artist who poetically blends the styles of folk and indie pop with Celtic storytelling to create an artistic world of their own. In the summer of 2023, Madóc taught herself to play guitar. Since then, they have independently released their 2025 debut EP ‘Adrenaline Demos’ and completed a 13 show West Coast tour. With influence from Dolores O’Riordan of The Cranberries, Maggie Rogers and Chappell Roan, Madóc uses her powerful vocals and tender lyrics of self-care to create songs that bring listeners into the truths of their rawest selves. She is best known for her striking performances that are both intimate and explosive.

Supporting Madóc is musical powerhouse and friend, Prophet PM with his band. Prophet PM is a Boston-based artist known for his soulful vocals that move mountains and make memories from his electric personality and performance. He recently went viral for his 2026 Somerville Porchfest set that showed exactly this. Prophet PM is a beloved local artist in the Boston scene and was named a finalist for The Art of Elysium’s “The People’s Artist” in 2026. His influences are Marvin Gaye, Otis Redding, Bon Iver, Bill Withers and RIchie Havens.

Both Madóc and Prophet PM are educators and active community members in the greater Boston area. In the spirit of “Cake,” they will be collecting donations for the Cambridge Community Center Food & Supply Pantry throughout the show!

about: Rich Hinman returns to the Lizard Lounge with Kevin Barry, Zach Hickman and John Sands November 11th!
$15/$20 Door · Doors 7

On his recent LP “Memorial,” on Colorfield Records, multi-instrumentalist and composer Rich Hinman creates an arresting collage containing elements of electronica, psychedelia, and searching improvisation, with Hinman’s pedal steel as the (mostly) primary voice. Here he debuts a new band of like-minded explorers featuring local heroes Kevin Barry (Jackson Browne, Rosanne Cash) on guitar and lap steel, Zachariah Hickman (Josh Ritter, Ray LaMontagne) on acoustic bass and John Sands (Aimee Mann) on drums.

about: The Reckoning Crew returns to the Lizard Lounge December 10th at 8 o’clock!
$15/20 door · Doors 7

The Reckoning Crew brings together stalwart members of the Boston Grateful Dead scene to present an authentic emulation of the Dead’s iconic acoustic performances captured on the “Reckoning” album. Not limited to just this period of the Dead’s career, The Reckoning Crew, featuring David Rubin & Ian Brenckle from Diamond Blues, Mark Munzer of Playing Dead, Mike Verge from Torn and Frayed and Ben DeUrso of Citizens’ Dead, has a deep love for all of the material of the storied songbook, and showcases that along with a fierce focus on improvisation & communication for a real good time!

events.title: Samantha Farrell’s “A Blue Christmas”
about: Join us for Samantha Farrell’s "A Blue Christmas" – a joyful holiday extravaganza at Lizard Lounge Dec 11th!
With special guest appearances by Abbie Barrett, James Rohr, Mark Lipman, Halley Elwell and more!
The houseband for the evening will be the incomparable Chris Hersch & the MoonRaiders.
Each performer will croon their favorite holiday classics and originals of the hall-decking and bell jingling variety.
Expect an evening imbued with jazz-tinged nostalgia, existential angst, warm and moody blues, and some rare, rootsy rock renditions of more obscure holiday gems.
Come embrace the spirit of the holidays with Samantha Farrell and friends, and make this Blue Christmas one to remember!

events.title: Clamb “Quiche Mountain” Release w/Targus Targus and Digital Awareness
about: Clamb celebrates the release of "Quiche Mountain" with Targus Targus and visuals by Digital Awareness Dec 12th!
$15/$20 door · Doors 7

CLAMB was born out of a Dadaist desire to create music free from societal norms of perfection. They dig deep into the groove of soulful American music from the infinite James Brown and Alice Coltrane to the aether of seventies European krautrock pioneers like Cluster and Harmonia to patiently sketch foreign landscapes from the ground up. Clamb are devoted to keeping an attitude of acceptance in their largely-improvised songs, choosing a direction and exploring its corners and nuances to tell stories without words. Their 2026 release “Quiche Mountain” expands on the band’s prior work with the addition of Samuel Crawford on guitar, and features a development of the group’s trademark improvisational style.

Targus Targus is a video game music (VGM)-inspired synth powerhouse. Originating out of frontman Dave Holmes’ deep-seated love for classic retro gaming and modular synthesizers, the project initially evolved in the Boston indie underground as a solo endeavor before expanding into a formidable, lock-stepped live band.

Characterized by complex lead synth lines and a relentless rhythm section, the band crafts sonic landscapes that make listeners feel like they are dodging lasers in an unreleased 16-bit space shooter. Shunning overly serious artistic pretension, Targus Targus labels their serialized discography with a sense of continuous play.

about: Guitarist Ahren Shreeve returns to the Lizard Lounge with his trio Dec 16th at 8 o'clock!
Doors 7

Ahren Shreeve is a session/touring guitarist and educator known for his expressive, vocal-inspired playing. Blending blues, R&B, and soul, he brings a unique feel-driven approach shaped by years of live performance and collaboration. Utilizing his improvisational skills and melodic expression, Ahren performs his interpretations of classic and familiar tunes.
In addition to performance work, Ahren maintains a growing online platform sharing performance-driven guitar content, inspiring a global audience of musicians & collaborators.

events.title: Jake Manzi/Lux Deluxe
about: Jake Manzi returns to the Lizard Lounge with Lux Deluxe December 17th
$15/$20 Door · Doors 7

Raised in western MA and residing in Los Angeles, Jake’s unique brand of folk rock has earned him significant acclaim, sold-out hometown shows, and opening slots for Dawes, NRBQ, Ron Sexsmith, M. Ward, Lori McKenna, and more.

After a decade of writing songs, making records, and touring across the country, Manzi presents his third full-length record, Getting Somewhere. Recorded mostly-live at Recorders in LA, it’s a confident, assured collection of no-frills Americana gems.

Getting Somewhere sees Manzi at his best, roadtipping through eleven songs that start in nostalgia and end up landing firmly in the present. “When you go, the trouble begins,” he sings, heartsick, in the first track. By the end of the record, accompanied by whirling organ and distant, roomy-sounding drums, things have changed: “I’m finally waking up.”

Co-produced with Gabriel Bernini, the album favors an invisible approach to production: complete takes captured live and minimally dressed up with overdubs. The songs breathe, and the performances speak for themselves. The result is vibrant and immediate, closer to what it sounds like when Manzi takes the stage.

With driving piano that nods to Jackson Browne, heartachey lap steel, and the shimmer of glockenspiel recalling Springsteen’s most energetic moments, Getting Somewhere takes us through winding roads with plenty of detours, landing in a place of quiet confidence, truehearted and speckled with delightful imperfections.

Jake is no stranger to collaboration. As part of a close-knit Italian family, he grew up singing around the table after homemade dinners. During a two-month artist residency in France, Manzi collaborated with guitarist (and Remi Wolf co-writer) Jack DeMeo. Together, under the name The Breadwinners, they released their first LP titled ‘Starter’ in February of 2026. DeMeo’s guitar and vocals appear on Getting Somewhere, alongside keyboardist Eli Salus-Kleiner, Tim Heidecker band lap and pedal steel player Connor “Catfish” Gallagher, Mikaela Davis’ bassist Shane McCarthy, Charlie Faragher on drums, and many more. It’s a lineup featuring old and new: longtime Massachusetts pals who also made the westward migration, and new friends made in LA.
Written during a period of perpetual motion—bouncing from apartment to apartment, undergoing…

events.title: Yoni Gordon and the Goods/ Savoir Faire/Ryan Lee Crosby
about: Yoni Gordon and the Goods, Savoir Faire and Ryan Lee Crosby live at the Lizard Lounge Dec 18th!
Doors 7

At this point these guys are an indie rock institution. We have watched them grow for a scrappy, power-pop trio, to now being a 5 piece band playing songs that have as much heart as they do heat. Yoni Gordon continues to be a purveyor of the sing-a-long chorus and powerful guitar riffs. Fez Aswat and Scott Eisenberg are still one of the most solid rhythm sections around. The band is rounded out with the chiming guitar of Amer Koudis (no one else approaches guitar quite like him), and the band boasts not one but two excellent keyboard players – Wes Shippee and Dan Papson.These guys are the rare band that has been around forever, but keep getting better with every release.

Savoir Faire is an Iranian American guitarist and songwriter fusing jazz crooner elements, Persian undercurrents, and alternative rock influences. Her 2025 debut album, “Hopeless Nostalic,” is a Lynchian rumination on the past and present that earned nominations from “Jazz Artist of the Year” (Boston Music Awards, 2025) and “Songwriter of the Year” (New England Music Awards, 2025), amongst others. Her most recent release, an EP titled “This Too Shall Pass,” was released on October 8th.

With an intercontinental band, singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Ryan Lee Crosby blends essences of American folk-blues and North Indian raga into meditative songs of impermanence, compassion and joy. Crosby’s music is a pleasing mix of improvised and composed material, performed on traditional and modern instruments. Through his recordings and performances, Crosby hopes to inspire peace, openness and respect – for tradition, for culture, for each other and for one’s self.

“Brady Dallas Jones blends an introspective and musing lyrical style with the dramatic folk rock sound he was raised on to create a Boston-brewed mixture capable of bringing an audience to their knees, whether it be in sadness or ecstasy.” – Arlo Matthews Brady Dallas Jones

events.title: Wailer Wednesdays with The Duppy Conquerors
about: The Duppy Conquerors bring their celebration of the music of Bob Marley to the Lizard Lounge Dec 30th EVENT IS 21+

The quintessential Bob Marley tribute band – the Duppy Conquerors – is a rich collection of high-caliber musicians playing in tribute to the music of Bob Marley. Nominated for a Boston Music Award, this 10-piece ensemble of veteran musicians embodies a soulful authenticity that honors the artist and his timeless collection. With nearly 80% of Marley’s repertoire under their belts, the Duppy Conquerors are equipped to provide hours of entertainment and positive vibrations.

events.title: Ward Hayden & The Outliers NYE
about: Ward Hayden & The Outliers ring in the new year with their celebration of the life, legacy and music of Hank Williams Boston is one of America’s great music towns. But among the various styles the city is known for that have launched many musical acts to success and stardom, country music wasn’t a truly thriving genre there, that’s until singer, songwriter and guitarist Ward Hayden and his band The Outliers (formerly known as Girls Guns & Glory) sang and played their distinctive take on C&W with a rock’n’roll kick to the top of the Boston scene and a thriving, critically-acclaimed and highly-awarded career across America and in Europe.Beginning in 2010 Ward and his collection of bandmates & musician friends began gathering together on Jan 1st to kick off every new year and honor the life and legacy of one of their biggest musical influences: HankWilliams.HankWilliams lived for just 29 short years, but what a lasting and meaningful legacy he left behind.Hank left this world on Jan 1, 1953 and every year Ward has assembled an incredible collection of songs from Hank’s catalog, with new surprises, country classics, & deep cuts added every single year.In addition to performing a full set of Hank’s music, each year the band also performs a set of Ward Hayden & the Outliers original songs.For fans of Hank, fans of Country Music, & fans of Ward & the Outliers, it doesn’t get much better than this. And it’s a rare chance to catch the band in the intimate environment of the Lizard Lounge, a venue in which the band has really cut their teeth & where they have returned to every year for this very special & unique show. Join us this year for Ward Hayden & the Outliers 18th Annual Celebration of Hank Williams at the Lizard Lounge.

events.title: Hooly J Chan Full Band and Jessye DeSilva
about: Hooly J Chan Full Band and Jessye DeSilva Through music and puppetry Hooly J Chan and full band tell a love story for earthlings… transmitted from extraterrestrials… In this story we witness an earthling getting taken up into the beyond and coming back down again… A consciousness altering experience. The high of coming in contact with the aliens… of coming in contact with ourselves… of coming in contact with our earthly impact while we’re here…

Hooly J Chan is a story teller, singer songwriter and puppeteer based in the South Coast of Massachusetts. Co-founder of The Wicked Queer Puppet Theater, hooly creates musical and visual art to expand our imagination of what is possible. Contact High is hoolys 4th full length album. Their band includes woodwinds, strings, bass, guitars, and drums and together they take audience on a journey into the ethers! Contact High is a story about coming in deeper contact with ourselves, each other, our Earth and the beyond…

Jessye DeSilva seamlessly blends theatrical pop elements with traditional folk and roots music to form her piano-driven alt-americana sound. She infuses hope into songs about religious alienation, mental health struggles, and societal injustice to create a uniquely queer and unholy ruckus. Jessye’s latest album Glitter Up the Dark was produced by Aaron Lee Tasjan and incorporates Eighties pop and Nineties alternative flourishes to the stately Americana and country-rock sounds of 2023’s Renovations and 2022 debut Landscapes, which earned her a nomination for Americana Artist of the Year at the 2022 Boston Music Awards. No Depression says “Comparisons to Elton John and Brandi Carlile are easy — DeSilva clearly takes a page from these idols, anchoring [her] songs in pop melody juggernauts, gauzy textures, and vocal bravado.” Nashville Scene named her a 2023 Artist To Watch, saying “DeSilva could inject new life into a genre that could definitely use a little more pretzel logic.”

about: Michael Bravata: “The Montcalms” Release Show Celebrating the release of his 2026 album The Montcalms, Michael Bravata will perform the record live in its entirety, backed by a full band, including a strings section. Musicians who helped record the album will join him on stage to recreate its fully acoustic, all-natural instrumentation at The Rockwell.
Michael Bravata is a Boston-based experimental guitarist and composer who has spent his career creating a catalog of evocative and immersive avant-garde pieces.

Born in Texas, Michael spent his formative years in the vibrant indie music scenes of Dallas and Austin. While pursuing a degree at UTA, Michael wrote and created music driven through post-rock and drone genres.

Over the past decade, Michael’s insatiable appetite for artistic exploration and growth has led him to the experimental world of ambient landscapes. This shift marked an evolution in his music, reflecting a deeper examination of acoustic textures and immersive atmospheres. Michael’s writing is contemplative, blending the introspective nature of indie rock with ambient’s boundless creativity.

In 2024, Michael completed a Composing and Orchestrating for Film and Television certificate at the Berklee College of Music. This leap has further pushed his pursuits by incorporating orchestral and traditional instrumentation into his work.

events.title: Homeboy Sandman, NAHreally, Loman, & Jesse The Tree
about: Homeboy Sandman, NAHreally, Loman, & Jesse The Tree NYC indie rap legend Homeboy Sandman is joined by NAHreally, Loman, and Jesse The Tree for a night of hip-hop at The Rockwell.

Homeboy Sandman is a Hip-Hop artist from Queens, NY. He is highly revered for his thought-provoking lyrics, impeccable flow, and unmatched authenticity. Over his long-standing career, he has received critical praise from Rolling Stone, Associated Press, Pitchfork, The FADER, XXL Magazine, Complex, NPR, and more. Homeboy Sandman has released albums with notable record labels such as Stones Throw, Rhymesayers, and Mello Music Group, as well as his own imprint Dirty Looks. In addition to his accomplished solo career, Homeboy Sandman is also 1/2 of the legendary Hip-Hop duo Lice alongside Aesop Rock.

NAHreally is a Jersey City-based rapper, beatmaker, and show organizer from Massachusetts. Known for his conversational lyrics and laid back production, he’s steadily built a catalog of 10+ releases since 2016. In that same span, his DIY approach to performing, touring, and putting on shows has made him a fixture in the NYC indie rap scene. His music has been covered by Cabbages, Bandcamp Daily, Hearing Things, Okayplayer, and more. His latest album Extra Cheese is out now on Bandcamp via Three Dollar Pistol.

Jesse The Tree is a rapper and producer from Providence, RI. His clever, layered lyricism and introspective storytelling offer a balance of poetry and relatability rarely found in an MC. Tree has built a name around New England and beyond through a steady stream of independent releases and relentless touring. His solo catalog alongside his work as 1/2 of sleepingdogs with rapper/producer Andrew has turned him into a mainstay in indie rap. His music has been covered by Bandcamp Daily, The Rap Music Plug Podcast, Secret House Against, and more. His latest releases Worm in Heaven (Strange Famous) and Dog Complex (Three Dollar Pistol) offer a glimpse into his versatility and craftsmanship both on the mic and behind the boards.

events.title: ‘SLC Punk’ Watch Party + Unplugged Performances
about: ‘SLC Punk’ Movie Watch Party + Unplugged Performances Featuring Kooked Out, Anemoia, & Katie and The Roses + Merch Swap!
The Scene Within The Scene Presents its first Movie Watch Party, Merch Swap and Acoustic Unplugged Series on January 3rd at The Rockwell in Davis Square.
Movie: The 1998 cult classic ‘SLC Punk’ Merch Swap: Bring your merch, trade, exchange, donate with local artists, musicians and friends.
Acoustic unplugged performances by Kooked Out, Anemoia and Katie and The Roses.

The kaleidoscopic sound of Kooked Out has evolved naturally throughout the years and draws influences from almost every genre and decade of music from the 1930s to present day, crafting a unique mix of styles and sounds that have developed Kooked Out a cult-like following in the skate and surf communities. Leaning heavily into the music of the ’50s, ’60s and early 2000s, Kooked Out’s genre-spanning sound has become a calling card, both on record and live on stage, appropriate for a creative outlet that lists its top influences as The White Stripes, The Beatles, Jimi Hendrix, Dick Dale, The Black Keys, Cage The Elephant, and Blink-182.” -Michael Marotta / Knyvet Members: John Fiore, Chris Laskey, Chris Caduto, Emily Trubey / ‘2024 Live Act Of The Year’ New England Music Awards Anemoia is a Boston based alternative band crafting a distinctive murky pop sound that blends atmospheric guitars, emotional vocals, and cinematic songwriting. Drawing inspiration from across generations of alternative music, the band is quickly gaining attention for their striking debut releases “Anemoia” and “Enviro Maniac.”

Katie and the Roses is a Boston-based alternative/indie band playing original music with a soulful, rock-influenced sound. Their songs combine expressive vocals, catchy melodies, and emotionally honest songwriting, moving between intimate moments and energetic, guitar-driven performances. With a warm, dynamic sound and a modern edge, Katie and the Roses bring an engaging original set to the stage.

events.title: Boston Celtic Music Festival 2027
about: The 24th annual Boston Celtic Music Festival presented by Passim, known as BCMFest, returns to Club Passim, Somerville Theatre, Crystal Ballroom, Arts at the Armory, and The Rockwell January 14-17, 2027. Presented by Passim, a Cambridge-based non-profit that supports a vibrant music community through Club Passim, the Passim School of Music, artist grants and outreach initiatives. The 2027 festival will showcase Greater Boston’s deep tradition of music, song and dance from Irish, Scottish, Cape Breton, Quebecois and other Celtic communities. BCMFest features acts that are traditional as well as others that draw on contemporary sounds and ideas; full-time, professional touring acts as well as local session musicians; highlighting performers from across the generations.

Saturday’s Dayfest offers over six hours of entertainment, from mid-morning until 6 pm. Artists will be presenting all manner of Celtic music, from classic traditional to contemporary sounds. All events will take place in Davis Sq. in Somerville at The Crystal Ballroom, The Rockwell, and Dragon’s Lair Pizza (for our sessions). about: $15 @ the door / $10 students / 8:30 start / 8pm doors / seated Jerry Bergonzi, Tenor Saxophone Luther Gray, Drums Plamen Karadonev, Piano Sean Farias, Bass Special Guest, Trumpet Double-click to edit...

A fine, high-powered tenor saxophonist with a tone influenced by John Coltrane, a mastery of chord changes, and a strong musical imagination, Jerry Bergonzi has long had an underground following in the Boston area. Bert Seager, pianist, composer, recording artist, and educator, has led performances in international jazz festivals in Canada, Peru, Bulgaria, Jordan, Ecuador, Israel, China and Japan. about: $12 advance / $15 day of show / 9:15 doors / 9:30 music / all ages Brooklyn-based songwriter Eliza Edens celebrates the release of their latest record 'Death Drive.' Local songwriter Nora Meier supports.

<a href=" class="sqs-block-button-element--small sqs-button-element--tertiary sqs-block-button-element" data-sqsp-button Eliza Edens is a Brooklyn-based songwriter who writes songs that dance inside the white-hot intersection of pleasure and pain. Bold and sincere, their songs are like antique cameo necklaces–snapshots of tenderness, worn close to the heart. A palette of punchy electric guitars and drums, gentle keys, and flourishes of saxophone and electronic percussion accent Edens’ voice as they sing of lovers & lilacs, grief & gratitude, and Freud’s “death drive.” Chameleonic in nature, Edens touches corners of pop, rock, folk, and country–with their voice as the glue that binds each genre foray together into a commanding sound.

Edens came up initially on the DIY songwriter circuit–playing self-booked tours of small clubs and listening rooms on the quiet success of 2020’s Time Away From Time and 2022’s lush acoustic-fingerpicked We’ll Become the Flowers. They earned praise from outlets such as Paste Magazine, The Nashville Scene, Spill Magazine, and Americana UK while incessantly touring across America. Cutting their teeth on the road eventually paid off as Edens won runner-up at the esteemed Telluride Troubadour Songwriting competition in 2024. The veneer of a quiet songster singing breezy Nick Drake-esque melodies was quickly dashed after Edens lost their mother in late 2024 after a long journey with early-onset dementia. After releasing 2025’s lo-fi collection of voice memos it’s your birthday & you’re gorgeous with no fanfare or promotion, Edens disappeared from touring for the better part of a year. Some say Edens went out to New Mexico to find god. Others say Edens turned into a butterfly and floated south to greener pastures. Edens will say that they continued to find hope in writing songs.

Newly molded by the black hole of grief, the singer reemerges this fall with their first record in 4 years. Death Drive is the sound of someone finding themself while also losing control. Heavy and light, black and neon-tinged, the album is a masterful achievement of contemporary indie rock, poignantly moving through the landscape of grief while also foisting…

events.title: Jesse Gallagher + Steve Fell
about: $10 admission / 7pm / seated show Jesse Gallagher began living above the Lilypad in 2006, just a few blocks from where his grandfather grew up on Inman st. At the time Jesse was in the middle of what would be about a decade of regular touring, performing & recording with his psychedelic rock band Apollo Sunshine. The band was featured in the New York Times, Rolling Stone, Spin & shared the stage with legendary acts Wu-Tang Clan, Toots & The Maytals, The Flaming Lips & Dr. Dog. Jesse has been involved with the Lilypad for 20 years and the full time talent booking agent since 2013.

Breaking Bad used Jesse’s song “We are Born When We Die” (2008) to dramatic effect. “Today is the Day” (2005) was in international Nike commercials while his “Singing to the Earth to Thank Her For You” was used in a large GAP campaign. Gallagher has collaborated, recorded & performed extensively w/ Sam Cohen, Willy Mason, Lilys, Nick Nicely, Doug Tuttle & Edan. Gallagher is a certified Yoga & Meditation teacher and hosts classes at the Lilypad & online. Since 2018, he has released 40 pieces of instrumental music which have been used in millions of YouTube videos ranging from NBC NY to Tesla and most recently a string of viral videos by Emma Chamberlain. Gallagher has a very active YouTube channel, making lots of psychedelic music videos and building a community of mindful listeners.

events.title: Joe Hunt Group
about: $15 admission / Start 8:30pm / Doors 8pm / Seated Show Modern jazz played by Boston's best jazz musicians.

Joe Hunt is a jazz drummer, educator, author, and historian. In the early 1960s, Joe Hunt performed and recorded alongside the late NEC Distinguished Artist-in-Residence Emeritus George Russell, with releases on Decca and Riverside. Hunt joined The Stan Getz Quartet in 1964, recording several releases on Verve, then was a member of the Bill Evans Trio from 1966-1967. The remainder of the 1960s found Hunt performing or recording with several other jazz luminaries including Chet Baker, Eric Dolphy, Dizzy Gillespie, Dexter Gordon, Charles Mingus, Bob Brookmeyer, and the late Herb Pomeroy.

In the 1970s and 1980s, Hunt was a member of The National Jazz Ensemble, led jazz groups with John Scofield, Mike Stern, and Santi Debriano, and toured with quartets of Red Rodney and Hal McKusick. The 1990s, and beyond, have included membership in The Smithsonian Jazz Masters Orchestra, with former NEC president Gunther Schuller, performances with Kenny Burrell, Joe Lavano, Joanne Brackeen, and Tal Farlow, as well as recordings with the Bert Seager Quintet, and also, Trio. Hunt is the author of the 1994 book 52nd Street Beat, which is a historical look at jazz drummer greats from 1945 to 1965.

Mark Pinto - alto saxophone, formerly years with the Buddy Rich band John Lockwood – bass, formerly with Joe Henderson, Lee Konitz, current Fringe member Yuka Hamano Hunt – piano, voice, arranger Joe Hunt – drums, formerly with George Russell, Stan Getz, Jim Hall, Dexter Gordon, and Bill Evans We pay tribute to a special composer or performer at most performances. Recent shows have included: Burt Bacharach, Ahmad Jamal, Bill Evans, and Gigi Gryce. Future shows will include the music of Paul and Carla Bley, and arranger, Johnny Mandel.
Continuing of the 3rd Sunday of Every Month

about: $15 suggested / $5 with Student ID / 6:30pm start / seated Bert Seager’s Heart of Hearing is a-jazz quartet made up of piano, tenor-saxophone, upright-bass, and drums whose aim is to bring listeners into the heart of improvised jazz. Bert Seager, pianist, composer, recording artist, and educator, has led performances in international jazz festivals in Canada, Peru, Bulgaria, Jordan, Ecuador, Israel, China and Japan. As a composer, he is a three-time recipient of the prestigious MacDowell Colony fellowship, an artists residency program in Peterborough, New Hampshire. He has recorded 18 compact discs which have all been released internationally to critical acclaim. Cadence Magazine says Bert’s music is filled with “effervescent optimism.” And the Boston Globe wrote that his “kind of exuberance makes the jazz world go round.”

In addition to his performing career, Rick is a full Professor at Berklee College of Music where he teaches ear training, improvisation, saxophone, and ensembles. He earned his doctorate in jazz composition from New England Conservatory, a master’s degree in jazz performance from the Eastman School of Music, and a bachelor’s degree in music education from Indiana University of PA.

Bassist Andrew Schiller, after living in Brooklyn NY, for five years, working as a bandleader and sideman playing jazz and improvised music, came to Boston to earn his doctorate in music from the New England Conservatory in 2020. Andrew’s debut album, "Tied Together, Not To The Ground," was released in May 2017, and his most recent project is "Sonoran," an 9-part suite for quintet are both on Red Piano Records. events.title: Allan Chase Quartet
about: $15 admission / 6pm doors / 6:20 start / seated Original jazz compositions by the members of the band.

Allan Chase - alto & soprano saxophones Nate Radley - guitar Bruno Råberg - bass Gen Yoshimura - drums Allan Chase is a saxophonist and composer who has performed jazz and improvised music since 1974 with his own groups and as a member of the Lewis Nash-Allan Chase Duo (1979-80), Your Neighborhood Saxophone Quartet (1981-2018), Prima Materia with Rashied Ali (1992-2000), the Steve Lantner Quartet with Joe Morris and Luther Gray, the Bruno Råberg Quartet and Tentet, and the Ayn Inserto Jazz Orchestra. He appears as a soloist on over sixty jazz and improvised music recordings, several rock and classical recordings, and several movie scores.

Chase began teaching at Berklee in 1981 and served as chair of Ear Training there (2008-21). He has also taught at Tufts and NEC, where he served as chair of Jazz Studies, dean of faculty, and chair of Contemporary Improvisation, and continues to teach jazz history courses.

events.title: Joe Hunt Group
about: $15 admission / Start 8:30pm / Doors 8pm / Seated Show Modern jazz played by Boston's best jazz musicians.

Joe Hunt is a jazz drummer, educator, author, and historian. In the early 1960s, Joe Hunt performed and recorded alongside the late NEC Distinguished Artist-in-Residence Emeritus George Russell, with releases on Decca and Riverside. Hunt joined The Stan Getz Quartet in 1964, recording several releases on Verve, then was a member of the Bill Evans Trio from 1966-1967. The remainder of the 1960s found Hunt performing or recording with several other jazz luminaries including Chet Baker, Eric Dolphy, Dizzy Gillespie, Dexter Gordon, Charles Mingus, Bob Brookmeyer, and the late Herb Pomeroy.

In the 1970s and 1980s, Hunt was a member of The National Jazz Ensemble, led jazz groups with John Scofield, Mike Stern, and Santi Debriano, and toured with quartets of Red Rodney and Hal McKusick. The 1990s, and beyond, have included membership in The Smithsonian Jazz Masters Orchestra, with former NEC president Gunther Schuller, performances with Kenny Burrell, Joe Lavano, Joanne Brackeen, and Tal Farlow, as well as recordings with the Bert Seager Quintet, and also, Trio. Hunt is the author of the 1994 book 52nd Street Beat, which is a historical look at jazz drummer greats from 1945 to 1965.

Mark Pinto - alto saxophone, formerly years with the Buddy Rich band John Lockwood – bass, formerly with Joe Henderson, Lee Konitz, current Fringe member Yuka Hamano Hunt – piano, voice, arranger Joe Hunt – drums, formerly with George Russell, Stan Getz, Jim Hall, Dexter Gordon, and Bill Evans We pay tribute to a special composer or performer at most performances. Recent shows have included: Burt Bacharach, Ahmad Jamal, Bill Evans, and Gigi Gryce. Future shows will include the music of Paul and Carla Bley, and arranger, Johnny Mandel.

Breaking Bad used Jesse’s song “We are Born When We Die” (2008) to dramatic effect. “Today is the Day” (2005) was in international Nike commercials while his “Singing to the Earth to Thank Her For You” was used in a large GAP campaign. Gallagher has collaborated, recorded & performed extensively w/ Sam Cohen, Willy Mason, Lilys, Nick Nicely, Doug Tuttle & Edan. Steve Fell is a guitarist, composer, and educator whose performing and recording career over the last twenty five years has reached across the boundaries of jazz, experimental, funk, free form improvisation, rock, electronic, reggae/calypso, hip-hop, psych, and many others.
He co-leads the groups Clear Audience, Quantum Banditos, Dome Room, and Astronomico, leads a trio under his own name, and collaborates with numerous bands and artists.

events.title: Barabas - Orbit | Album Launch Concert
about: $22 admission / 7:15 doors / 7:30 show / seated & standing <a href=" class="sqs-block-button-element--small sqs-button-element--tertiary sqs-block-button-element" data-sqsp-button > Get Tickets Orbit is the new solo album by Hungarian trumpeter, pianist, and composer Lőrinc Barabás, who now performs his solo project under the name Barabas. The album is a cinematic and meditative musical journey where neoclassical piano, ambient soundscapes, and electronic textures come together.
The ten compositions explore the ideas of movement and cycles. As the world around us moves ever faster, the music invites listeners to slow down, turn inward, and discover moments of stillness.
Trumpet, piano, and synthesizers engage in a musical dialogue, creating a sound world that is both intimate and expansive, moving between ambient, neoclassical, and electronic music.

Throughout his nearly two-decade career, Lőrinc Barabás has released thirteen albums, performed regularly across Europe and the United States, and collaborated with artists including Erik Truffaz, Takuya Kuroda, Niklas Paschburg, and Valerie June.
His international appearances include the EFG London Jazz Festival at the Barbican, the Jazzycolors Festival in Paris, The Town Hall in New York City, Expo 2020 Dubai, and Expo 2025 Osaka.

The album launch concert at The Lilypad in Cambridge, just outside Boston, brings the world of Orbit to life on stage, where acoustic instruments and electronics merge into one continuous, immersive musical experience.

about: $15 @ the door / $10 students / 8:30 start / 8pm doors / seated Jerry Bergonzi, Tenor Saxophone Luther Gray, Drums Plamen Karadonev, Piano Sean Farias, Bass Special Guest, Trumpet Double-click to edit...

A fine, high-powered tenor saxophonist with a tone influenced by John Coltrane, a mastery of chord changes, and a strong musical imagination, Jerry Bergonzi has long had an underground following in the Boston area. He started on clarinet when he was eight, switching to alto at 12, and finally to tenor two years later. Bergonzi was inspired early on by Sonny Rollins, Coltrane, and Hank Mobley. He attended Lowell University and then after graduation played electric bass in local bands behind singers and strippers, saving up enough money to move to New York in 1972. After struggling in the Big Apple for seven years and gaining some recognition as a member of Two Generations of Brubeck and of the Dave Brubeck Quartet (with whom he appeared on several Concord albums during 1979-1981), Bergonzi moved back to Boston in 1981, where he developed a strong career both as a tenorman and as an educator. He has since led several groups (including two called Con Brio and Gonz) and recorded for the Plug, Not Fat, Red, and Blue Note labels. — By Scott Yanow, AllMusic Continuing Every Monday at 8:30pm Lineup subject to change

events.title: The Fringe
about: $15 @ the door / $10 students / 10pm doors / 10:30 start / seated The Fringe originally formed back in 1971 by tenor-saxophonist George Garzone, bassist Richard Appleman, and drummer Bob Gullotti as an outlet for their free jazz improvisations, The Fringe have entertained and enlightened Boston area jazz audiences for over 50 years. Bassist Appleman left the band in 1985 to become Chairman of the Bass Department at Berklee College and was replaced by veteran bassist John Lockwood.
Bob Gullotti passed away in 2020 and is remembered as one of the greatest jazz drummers of his generation. Francisco Mela, now on drums, graciously fills the space Bob left behind.

Along with their impressive tenure with The Fringe, Garzone, Lockwood, and Mela are in great demand as session players and have played with many of the greats of contemporary jazz. Along with keeping up with a busy performance schedule, each of them are well-respected educators helping to inspire the jazz musicians of tomorrow.
Continuing Every Monday at 10:30pm

about: $10 admission / 8:15 start / 8pm doors / Seated Show Inspired by the cartoon music of the 50s and 60s, the drive of Led Zeppelin, the genius and humor of Frank Zappa, the perfection of Bach, the relentlessness of Ligeti, the courage of Medeski, Martin and Wood, the jam of Phish live, the beauty of the Beatles and the immersive nature of music, I am in pursuit of truth through music.

about: Tito Puente Jr. comes to Arts at the Armory’s Spotlight Series on Friday, December 11, 2026!

The heir to the "King of Mambo," continues his passionate mission to nurture his father's magnificent Latin jazz and salsa legacy. Tito Puente, Jr. has made a name for himself as one of the most exciting Latin musicians touring today. Tito Puente Jr. carries his father with him – imprinted on his physical being and locked in his soul. It’s in his looks, his joy, and his music. Tito Jr. is on a passionate mission, determined to nurture the musical legacy left by his father.

He has found captive audiences who echo his passion. Crowds lured to a venue by the father are returning to see the son — and to once again participate in the high voltage celebration that takes place on stage and spills onto the dance floor.

Tito Puente, Jr. and his ensemble brings exhilarating Latin rhythms that will get your feet moving. With one foot in Boston and the other in the Caribbean, MetaMovements is an artist collective advancing community engagement and well-being through music, dance and participatory cultural events.

events.title: Arts at the Armory Spotlight Series Presents Blind Boys of Alabama
about: 6x Grammy Winners return to Somerville, celebrating Stevie Wonder’s “Songs in the Key of Life”
Arts at the Armory is thrilled to welcome back gospel legends Blind Boys of Alabama to the Spotlight Series on Friday, February 12, 2027.

This special presentation pairs many of Stevie Wonder’s classic songs with beloved selections from the Blind Boys’ own celebrated repertoire, blending gospel, soul, and Americana in a joyful performance that honors both musical legacies. With over 75 years of lifting spirits and moving souls, the Blind Boys continue their mission of spreading light and love through the universal language of music. In 2003, the Blind Boys earned a Grammy Award for an album that included their acclaimed cover of Stevie Wonder’s “Higher Ground,” a version later featured in film and television, including FX’s Fargo. In 2007, Stevie Wonder presented Blind Boys singer Jimmy Carter with a Vision Award for Lifetime Achievement, underscoring their enduring impact on music and culture.
Featuring classics like: “Sir Duke,” “I Wish,” “As,” and more.

The Blind Boys of Alabama are recognized worldwide as living legends of gospel music. Celebrated by The National Endowment for the Arts (NEA) and The Recording Academy/GRAMMYs with Lifetime Achievement Awards, inducted into the Gospel Music Hall of Fame, and winners of six GRAMMY® Awards, they have attained the highest levels of achievement in a career that spans over 70 years.
They have appeared on recordings with many artists, including Lou Reed, Peter Gabriel, Bonnie Raitt, Willie Nelson, Aaron Neville, Susan Tedeschi, Ben Harper, Patty Griffin, and Taj Mahal.
